title: HomeServices

listing.shortDescription: A clean, credible marketing site for a local services business — home, about and services pages with a consistent look and easy contact paths.
listing.fullDescription: HomeServices is a focused marketing website for a local services business. Three pages — home, about and services — present the offering clearly, build trust through the about page, and steer visitors toward contact. Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript keep it fast, accessible and trivially easy to host.

closing.conclusion: HomeServices gave the business a clean, credible web presence — three focused pages that explain the services and make it easy for local customers to get in touch.
